answer: Each identity must settle its first 10 payouts through a 14-day escrow, released only after a distinct counterparty confirms delivery, with a 3 POA fee per settlement. A sybil operator cannot whisper past the wait: the same capital cannot be recycled across fakes until each escrow clears, and no haven of instant payouts exists. Each extra fake locks another float for 14 days plus another fee, so 100 fakes tie up 100 times the capital and waiting of one honest identity, with cost rising thread by thread as counterparties must be distinct. Escrow receipts sit on-chain for any verifier to replay.
